title: Today Money
user: People who budget manually and do not want bank sync, but need a trustworthy answer to what can be spent today after upcoming obligations.
smallest_useful_product: Offline PWA where a user enters current cash, mandatory future bills, and protected envelopes; it computes a conservative daily amount through the next payday and exposes assumptions.
constraints: No financial advice or bank credential collection; calculations must be transparent and exportable; data stays on-device with optional encrypted backup; single-currency core.
